subject: Evaluation playbook kickoff & 30-day close timeline — NeuroWave
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@neurowave.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluation playbook kickoff & 30-day close timeline — NeuroWave

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the time today — really excited to get this moving. Per our conversation, I put together a short evaluation playbook to make the next 30 days predictable and visible for both teams. High level goals:

- Confirm success criteria (production latency target, throughput, cost per 1M tokens)
- Complete a technical evaluation (sample inference tests & infra fit)
- Finalize commercial terms and timeline to sign

Proposed 30-day cadence (high level):
1) Week 1: Kickoff + stakeholder alignment (this email) — confirm champion, tech owners, and legal contacts
2) Week 2: Tech deep dive & sample inference run (SE + infra)
3) Week 3: Results review + performance tuning (quantization/latency options)
4) Week 4: Final commercial review & sign/handoff to onboarding

Can you confirm the following by end of day tomorrow?
- Who will own the evaluation on your side (primary champion + secondary tech contact)
- Any hard dates or blackout windows in the next 30 days
- Data residency or compliance constraints we should account for now

I attached an evaluation_plan_template.xlsx to capture owners, deliverables, and dates. Jordan (cc) will own the tech runbook on our side; Marissa (cc) will own the success criteria and rollout checklist.

Suggested next step: 30-minute kickoff on Monday 6/15 at 10:00 AM PT — is that workable for you and Amit?

Thanks,

Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: evaluation_plan_template.xlsx
From: Priya Shah <priya@neurowave.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit@neurowave.ai>
Date: 2026-06-10T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation playbook kickoff & 30-day close timeline — NeuroWave

Sofia —

Thanks, this looks great and aligned with how we want to move. I (Priya) will be the primary champion and Amit (CTO) will be the tech owner for the evaluation. A couple of quick notes:

- We have a product release window the week of 6/22 that restricts heavy-system testing to after 6/24 — would it be possible to shift the sample inference run to week 3 (starting 6/24) and compress week 2 activities into a short pre-check?
- Data residency: we need the test dataset to remain in US regions; please confirm the hosted evaluation will not route data through EU nodes.
- Legal: our procurement team prefers an initial SOW-lite prior to full contract redlines — I attached a draft SOW for your review (neurowave_sow_v1.pdf).

Monday 6/15 at 10:00 AM PT works for me and Amit — please send an invite.

Best,
Priya Shah
Head of ML Platform | NeuroWave
priya@neurowave.ai

Attachment: neurowave_sow_v1.pdf

To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya@neurowave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation playbook kickoff & 30-day close timeline — NeuroWave

Thanks Priya — and great to meet you virtually. Quick notes from the infra/SE side:

- We can run the lightweight pre-check next week (scripts + environment sanity) without heavy load; then schedule the full sample inference runs starting 6/24 as requested.
- Data residency: confirmed — we will provision test endpoints in us-west-2 for the evaluation and add explicit region pins in the runbook.
- Helpful if you can share a < 1GB sample of the dataset ahead of the run so we can pre-validate tokenization and sequence lengths. If sharing is sensitive, we can provide a synthetic sample that mirrors your distribution.

I’ll slot a 60-minute SE deep-dive for 6/25 at 11:00 AM PT unless you prefer a different time. Marissa: can you confirm SLO targets (latency p95, max tokens/session) so I can size the test instances?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks everyone for the quick confirmations. Confirming next steps:

- Kickoff: Mon 6/15 10:00 AM PT (calendar invite sent) — attendees: Priya (champion), Amit (CTO), Sofia (AE), Jordan (SE), Marissa (PM)
- Pre-check: lightweight scripts run 6/16–6/18 (Jordan to share checklist)
- Full sample inference run: starting 6/24 (Jordan to run; Marissa to validate SLOs)
- Commercial: Sofia to iterate SOW draft and share an initial pricing outline by 6/18

Links: HubSpot deal — https://hubspot.com/deals/12345678; shared runbook folder — https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1a2B3cExample

See you Monday.

Sofia
